incident: after a backend restart under heavy disk load (254 GB hash verification) every request incl. /api/health timed out for ~1-2 min; port listening, CPU idle
root_cause: py-spy: MainThread in JobStore.list -> read_text_retry, called synchronously from the async GET /api/direct-gen/jobs (the pult polls it); a slow disk read blocked the whole event loop

fix.what: GET /api/direct-gen/jobs and /jobs/{id} read job.json files via asyncio.to_thread; view() stays on the loop (it reads the in-memory queue the loop mutates); 404 shape unchanged

negative_test: command-center/tests/test_direct_gen_jobs_off_loop.py: store read sleeps 0.6 s; a concurrent /api/direct-gen/models must answer < 0.45 s and the store must never run on the loop thread; unknown id -> 404 unknown_job
not_proven: no live re-run under the same disk pressure; the other sync endpoints of the feature (models, delete) still run on the loop
next_step: move DirectGenService.delete and models() file walks off the loop as well
